ops.text: TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND RETURN OF CLIENT DATA. Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to 6 months at TrueLink's then-current rates; (b) within 30 days after expiry or termination of this Agreement, return to Client all Client Content and other Client data in TrueLink's possession or control in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Client Content and data from its systems and certify such deletion to Client in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a transition-assistance and data-return clause, since the Agreement requires Client to arrange replacement hosting but gives us no right to our own hosted data or migration help on exit. The return duty now runs within 30 days after expiry or termination and in a standard machine-readable format, with deletion certified thereafter, consistent with our preferred position.
proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance for up to 6 months at then-current rates, return of Client data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination, and certified deletion thereafter.
